statement: Lambda's on-demand list price for NVIDIA H100 SXM (8x instance) is $3.99 per GPU-hour on 2026-08-05.
why: H100 SXM on-demand pricing is the most widely quoted reference rate for rented accelerator capacity, so a vendor's public list price anchors what the market pays today.

impact.mechanism: A published on-demand rate sets the reference cost that renters compare against, shaping neocloud revenue per GPU-hour and the economics of buying versus renting merchant GPUs.

evidence.source: Lambda (Lambda Labs) — official GPU Cloud pricing page

confidence.basis: Verbatim list price from the vendor's own pricing page, but this is secondary-tier open-web evidence from a single publisher (Lambda) with no corroborating documents, so confidence is capped at medium.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.69 -> 3.99 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (Lambda Labs) — official GPU Cloud pricing page
